text.font-family: Segoe Print, Comic Sans MS, Arial, sans-serif

text.tspan: رجعت البيت فوجدت الماء يغرق الصالة،

text.font-family: Segoe Print, Comic Sans MS, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: You come home and find water
and the pipe is still dripping.

text.font-family: Segoe Print, Comic Sans MS, Arial, sans-serif

text.tspan: أم تغلق المحبس، أم تصلّح الماسورة؟ ولماذا؟

text.font-family: Segoe Print, Comic Sans MS, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: mop the floor, close the main valve,
